# ECN-2026-011 Change notice - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Reason for change
- Field inspection and maintenance review identified inconsistent coil cooling performance on EQ-P1-L1-IH03. The minimum acceptable coil cooling water flow was formalized to ensure reliable heater operation and to mitigate coil overheating risk. This change establishes the required minimum flow for operational and maintenance checks and aligns documentation with observed operational limits.
- Related documents: MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3, QS-PROC-01, SB-1009

Affected items
- EQ-P1-L1-IH03 induction coil cooling system: operational setpoints, in-line flow verification procedure, and associated maintenance checklists.
- Maintenance task lists and failure mode checks in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 that reference cooling verification for EQ-P1-L1-IH03.
- Process control and start/stop check against QS-PROC-01 to ensure flows are confirmed prior to heater run-up.

Implementation
- Update maintenance procedures in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 to require verification that the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 72 L/min prior to any heating cycle.
- Add an in-field checklist entry for flow confirmation to preventative maintenance and shift start routines referenced by QS-PROC-01 and SB-1009.
- For existing scheduled maintenance tasks, operators will record measured flow and tag out equipment if flow is below the specified minimum until corrective action is completed per MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3.
- Training: maintenance and operations personnel will receive a targeted briefing on the new minimum flow requirement and corresponding procedure updates; training materials will reference MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 and QS-PROC-01.

Approvals
- Engineering originator, Maintenance manager, and Operations manager approvals required in the document control system. Final record and checklist updates will be uploaded and linked to MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3, QS-PROC-01, and SB-1009 upon approval.
